english:
Picking up a <special/>Special Ammo Brick grants 1 stack of 'Accretion'. A <heavy/>Heavy Ammo Brick grants 3 stacks. Maximum of 20 stacks. Stacks persist until death.

Accretion decreases Ready/Stow Animation Duration per stack, reaching 25% decreased Ready/Stow Animation Duration at 20 stacks.

source.text:
2 Piece | Accretion

On Ammo Brick Pickup:
Grants stacks of Accretion, up to a maximum of 20 stacks. Stacks persist until death.
Special Ammo Bricks grant 1 stack of Accretion. Heavy Ammo Bricks grant 3 stacks of Accretion.

Accretion:
Grants a Ready/Stow Animation Duration Multiplier per stack, up to a maximum of 0.75x Ready/Stow Animation Duration at 20 stacks.
